about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Most Precious Blood of Our Lord Jesus Christ” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Admitted to the sacred banquet, O Lord, we have drawn water in joy from the Savior’s fountains; may His Blood, we beseech You, become for us a fountain of water springing up to everlasting life. He lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: of water springing up to everlasting life
